workflows.purpose: Verify that existing units, readers, and source layers form the declared coherent assembly.
workflows.start_when: Units or readers exist, but their order, inclusion, or build closure needs independent verification.
inputs: one exact Git commit and bounded path set
the declared unit or member inventory
the claimed assembly scope and predecessor generation
steps: replay every input identity
compare included units and order with the declared scope
replay build evidence or state explicitly that no build was run
record missing, extra, duplicated, or contradictory members
evidence: exact inventory equality or a discrepancy ledger
stop_conditions: input generation changes during the review
the claimed inventory cannot be reproduced
the scope crosses an undefined predecessor boundary
handback: exact next unresolved member or terminal statement

workflows.purpose: Continue existing work from one exact published cursor without reopening completed scope.
workflows.start_when: A current map names an exact next page, section, line, unit, or work boundary.
inputs: exact starting cursor and authority identity
current decisions, terminology, and unresolved-error history
steps: replay the predecessor and cursor
advance one bounded coherent range
preserve numbering, structure, decisions, and contradictory evidence
stop and record the first unprocessed boundary
evidence: coverage closure for the bounded range
stop_conditions: the cursor or authority cannot be reproduced
the source becomes illegible or structurally ambiguous
the bounded stopping point is reached
handback: method findings reusable by the next continuation

workflows.purpose: Test a workflow on a small representative range before any broad production claim.
workflows.start_when: A corpus is valuable but source quality, method, layout, or language feasibility is not yet established.
inputs: a stated hypothesis about the proposed method
steps: freeze the pilot inputs
produce one small inspectable result
test source fidelity, structure, and reproducibility
separate method findings from corpus-wide claims
stop_conditions: the representative source is not legally or technically accessible
the method loses mathematical structure
the pilot criteria are resolved
handback: recommended next bounded scope or rejection
workflow changes another mirror should reuse

workflows.purpose: Repair a named defect without silently rewriting unrelated or contradictory material.
workflows.start_when: A map, issue, ledger, or source comparison identifies an exact defective locus.
steps: reproduce the defect
apply the smallest source-supported correction
check local dependencies and rendered or structural consequences
preserve the rejected preimage and rationale
stop_conditions: the defect cannot be reproduced
the proposed fix lacks source support
the change would require an unbounded rewrite
handback: next repair cursor or terminal statement

workflows.purpose: Transcribe one exact source range while preserving mathematical and document structure.
workflows.start_when: A stable page-image or text authority and an unambiguous bounded range are available.
inputs: source identity and exact page or line range
steps: freeze the admitted source range
transcribe all substantive content in order
retain uncertain glyphs and structural ambiguities explicitly
verify range coverage against the source
stop_conditions: source identity or range changes
a page or symbol cannot be responsibly resolved
the bounded terminal line is reached

workflows.purpose: Translate one exact source-aligned range without changing mathematical scope or structure.
workflows.start_when: A stable source transcription or authority and a bounded target-language scope exist.
steps: preserve hypotheses, numbering, displays, references, and logical force
record difficult terminology and alternatives
compare the completed range against the source
keep workflow commentary outside the mathematical reader
stop_conditions: the source layer is unstable
a mathematical ambiguity cannot be resolved
the bounded stopping point is reached
handback: editable translation and exact source binding
next translation cursor or terminal statement

workflows.purpose: Propagate one verified authority correction through every affected maintained derivative.
workflows.start_when: A correction is accepted in an authority or canonical source layer and dependent targets are known.
steps: freeze the correction and dependency set
update each affected target independently
preserve language-specific decisions and nonaffected bytes
record targets that cannot yet be rebased
stop_conditions: the authority correction is disputed
a target dependency cannot be proven
all declared dependent targets are disposed

workflows.purpose: Reproduce or extend a scope independently so overlap yields comparable evidence rather than silent duplication.
workflows.start_when: Existing work is inspectable and an independent implementation or translation would provide useful comparison.
inputs: declared mirror scope and starting generation
steps: declare the mirror before broad production
preserve independence from the target where claimed
produce exact inspectable outputs
compare only after the independent result is frozen
stop_conditions: independence is broken before the claimed freeze
the source or scope cannot be bounded
the declared mirror range is completed or withdrawn
handback: mirror URL, commit, scope, and manifest
continuation, pause, return, or withdrawal state

workflows.purpose: Check an existing result without editing it and return reproducible findings to its owner.
workflows.start_when: A frozen target and sufficient source or structural evidence exist for a bounded review.
inputs: exact target commit, paths, bytes, and hashes
steps: replay target identities
perform the declared source, structure, language, formula, or visual checks
separate observations from source-adjudicated findings
leave target bytes unchanged
evidence: passes, failures, uncertainties, and reviewer limits
stop_conditions: target bytes differ from the declared generation
required authority is unavailable
the bounded review set is exhausted
handback: zero-change statement when no defect is found
recommended owner action without mutating the target

workflows.purpose: Compare a target directly against its stated ultimate or page-local authority.
workflows.start_when: Target bytes, an authority witness, and an exact comparison range are available.
steps: bind target units to source locators
check text, formulas, numbering, tables, diagrams, and references as applicable
classify every discrepancy and nonfinding
preserve authority uncertainty separately from target error
stop_conditions: authority identity or locator mapping fails
the target generation changes
the bounded comparison range is exhausted
handback: findings, nonfindings, and unresolved source questions

workflows.purpose: Locate candidate authorities for a future corpus without presenting intake as transcription or translation.
workflows.start_when: A high-value author or work lacks a bound, inspectable source baseline.
inputs: known editions, bibliographic leads, and gaps
steps: search authoritative repositories and catalogs
record provenance, access, edition, completeness, and image or text quality
deduplicate candidate witnesses
recommend but do not silently promote a source
evidence: bytes or hashes where lawfully and technically available
stop_conditions: no candidate meets the declared criteria
source identity or access cannot be established
a bounded intake candidate is selected
handback: selected intake recommendation or explicit no-source result

workflows.purpose: Bind a discovered source into exact, reproducible custody without claiming downstream work.
workflows.start_when: A candidate source has been selected and its provenance and scope can be recorded exactly.
inputs: source URL or custody path and edition identity
exact bytes or remotely verifiable identity
intended author, work, and scope binding
steps: freeze and hash the admitted source
record page count, structure, completeness, rights notes, and defects
create deterministic locators or manifests where useful
keep OCR and derivatives distinct from authority
stop_conditions: source provenance is contradictory
the admitted bytes change
the bounded source custody record is complete

workflows.purpose: Recover missing or ambiguous source, build, or provenance links for preserved target bytes.
workflows.start_when: A target exists but its authority, build inputs, member inventory, or generation lineage is incomplete.
inputs: known predecessor and candidate source evidence
steps: preserve the target unchanged
search only bounded candidate roots and public records
reconstruct candidate lineage through hashes, manifests, and build traces
distinguish proven, probable, conflicting, and missing links
stop_conditions: the bounded candidate set is exhausted
evidence conflicts without adjudication
the missing relation is proven or explicitly remains unknown

workflows.purpose: Verify table content, ordering, headings, alignment, and source coverage independently of surrounding prose.
workflows.start_when: A source or target contains mathematically material tables requiring dedicated structural review.
inputs: exact table range and target generation
source pages or authoritative table data
declared row, column, heading, and continuation rules
steps: bind every target table to its source locator
check headings, cells, ordering, continuations, notes, and mathematical symbols
record blank, merged, repeated, or structurally ambiguous cells
separate presentation defects from content defects
stop_conditions: source table geometry cannot be resolved
the target table generation changes
all bounded table cells are disposed
handback: audited table set and coverage totals

workflows.purpose: Maintain an independently governed Commons overlay on one exact read-only upstream pin and periodically synchronize without making upstream acceptance an approval gate.
workflows.start_when: The upstream repository, applicable license, exact commit, Commons namespace owner, and bounded overlay scope are all explicit.
inputs: one exact read-only upstream repository and commit
one exact Commons overlay commit and namespace
composition rules, tests, review receipts, and prior sync cursor
steps: replay the upstream pin and overlay identities without modifying upstream
compose deterministically and run the declared tests
review upstream movement against the last pin and record accepted, rejected, and conflicting changes
preserve stable Commons IDs, provenance, corrections, language links, and editorial independence
evidence: deterministic composition manifest and test results
sync decision, conflict, correction, and review receipts
stop_conditions: the upstream repository, license, or exact pin is not bound
Commons namespace ownership or write boundaries are unclear
composition is nondeterministic or a conflict lacks review
handback: new upstream pin, overlay commit, and composed-build identities
accepted, rejected, conflicting, and reversed sync decisions
next sync cursor and explicit upstream no-endorsement statement
